title4.text: 4 · Small frames in the chosen concepts

n_Main.text: RECOMMENDED. Run Sheet ledger: the running release rail is the hero, the flavor ledger reads local → testing → live, the console stays docked. Inspired by Xcode (debug area), GitHub Actions (job graph), App Store Connect + Play Console (version columns).

n_Overview_B_Canvas.text: Canvas: app, active job, runners and stores as nodes with wires. Best at "what runs where", weakest at "what is live". Inspired by Railway (project canvas), Codemagic and Bitrise (workflow graphs).

n_Overview_C_Timeline.text: Timeline first: the active release on top with the approval inline, then a feed. Inspired by Vercel (deployments), Buildkite (builds), Linear (activity), GitHub Actions (runs list).

n_Overview_A_Quiet.text: Quiet state: the same project before 5.4.1 was cut. No needs-you bar, console folded to one line, the hero says what is live.

n_Overview_Optional_Vitals.text: OPTIONAL: adoption and crash-free per live version. Needs store analytics the engine does not return.

n_Job_A_Graph.text: RECOMMENDED. Graph over steps + log: parallel jobs stay visible while you read one log. Inspired by GitHub Actions (graph + log), Buildkite (step list), Codemagic (build page).

n_Job_B_Navigator.text: Step navigator: tree on the left, log as the main pane, inspector on the right, app sidebar hidden. Inspired by Xcode (report navigator), Bitrise (build page).

n_Job_C_Timeline.text: Vertical timeline: stages run down the page and the running step opens its log inline. Inspired by Expo EAS (build page), Vercel (build logs), Buildkite.

n_Job_A_Failed.text: Failed: mataa_captain 1.3.6 (30), log opened at the error. The fix box is marked optional: steps have no failure-diagnosis field today.

n_Release_A_Lanes.text: RECOMMENDED. Two swimlanes under the hero, then timeline, notes, forced-update reminder and PR. Merge sits with the hero and says why it sleeps. Inspired by App Store Connect + Play Console (store states), GitHub (merge box).

n_Release_B_Timeline.text: Merged timeline with lane chips; Merge box and notes on the right. Inspired by GitHub (PR conversation), Linear (issue activity).

n_Release_C_Checklist.text: Checklist to Merge: the hero is the count of what is left. Inspired by Vercel (deployment checks), GitHub (merge box), App Store Connect (submission checklist).

n_Release_A_Rejected.text: New build, same version takes the next build number, 3285, because dev already used 3284. The reviewer message is optional: not in release data.

n_Approval_Notification.text: Review… opens the confirmation sheet in the main window; approvals never complete from a notification or the menu bar.
